uncited: This family integrates explicit geometric primitives or implicit surface fields with neural radiance fields to decouple geometry reconstruction from appearance modeling.
It addresses the slow convergence and ambiguous geometry of pure volumetric NeRFs by using surface boundaries to guide sampling and define radiance evaluation points.
The family builds on [Neural Radiance Fields](4972-neural-radiance-fields.md) by introducing geometric priors to guide radiance field optimization.
